description.value: Success Supermarket is a neighbourhood greengrocer in Richmond's Blundell area, offering fresh produce and grocery staples to the local community. Situated in a strip-mall unit, it would serve as a resupply point for cyclists riding Richmond's extensive dyke and connector trails.
